text:
priya: Heads-up — during the fp8 canary for convo-model-v3 we're seeing a small but consistent drop in persona safety and factuality on a 2% prompt subset. Want to lock down a short runbook for detecting and soft-rolling back quality regressions. Thoughts?

kevin: Ugh. Can you paste the failing prompts / metrics slice? Is it latency-related or model arithmetic noise? :thinking_face: 

priya: It's not latency. Mostly hallucination and persona drift on long-context prompts (8k+). Sample diffs show higher probability on unrelated continuations. Quick snapshot: QA F1 down 3.1 pts, persona-coherence down 4.7 pts on that slice.

alex: Could be kv-cache quant amplification with fp8 at long seqs. We saw something similar when we skipped per-layer calibration for attention weights. Did you run the per-layer calibration job?

priya: yes, calibration was run but we used auto-calibrate=true which skipped some small layers. I can re-run with per-layer explicit ops.

jordan: For a runbook I'd prefer three levels: detect -> triage -> action. Detect = automated regression alerts tied to eval set, triage = replicate locally and check per-layer activations, action = soft-fallback to int8 or degrade precision only for attention/ffn.

kevin: Agreed. Also add a config-level control so routing can fallback per-request. We want to avoid full fleet rollback if only a subset of workloads is affected. Example policy we discussed before: 

```
precision_policy:
  - match: { route: "chat-api", max_seq_len: 8192 }
    prefer: [fp8]
    fallback: [int8, fp16]
    metrics_guard:
      - name: "persona_coherence"
        window: 1000
        threshold: -2.0
        action: "fallback-to:int8"
```

kevin: ^ mechanism should be implemented in runtime router as a soft flag; don't spin a new deployment.

ml_ops_bot: deploybot: canary deploy started for convo-model-v3-fp8 @ 2351122338 

priya: For triage I'll run activation histograms and compare weight outliers. If we see amplification in attention-score scale that points to quantization error in attention matmul.

alex: If that's the case, a minimal mitigation is precision-gating: keep attn softmax and its pre-softmax matmul in int8/fp16 while still running remainder in fp8. It preserves most perf.

jordan: Add to runbook: test matrix should include long-context regen, persona probes, and prefix-embedding perturbation. Also add an embedding drift check (sometimes prompts with user names trigger different embeddings after quant).

kevin: Ops note: when doing per-request fallback, ensure token accounting doesn't blow up and expose flakey cost spikes. Add telemetry tag: quant_fallback=true so billing aggregation can be filtered.

priya: Good call. Also, add a checklist item: "If fallback rate > 0.5% over 10k reqs, trigger patch release and hold further canaries."

alex: One more: include a lightweight local repro harness snippet for SREs: 

```
# repro.sh
python -m repro.run --model convo-model-v3 --precision fp8 --evalset long_context_samples.json --compare-to int8
# outputs per-layer jacobian diffs and token-level logprobs
```

jordan: I'll draft the formal runbook and add links to calibration scripts and the per-layer visualizer. Target: publish to runbooks/quant-playbooks by EOD tomorrow.

priya: Thanks — for immediate action I'm going to pause canary expansion and rerun calibration with per-layer true. Will post results here. :thumbsup:

ml_ops_bot: deploybot: canary expansion paused at 2351122398 (reason: manual hold by priya)

kevin: Thanks team. If priya's re-calibration doesn't fix it, we'll enable precision-gating for attention and monitor.

priya: noted. will update within 2 hours with activation diffs and a recommended mitigation (gate vs fallback)
